name: Utter Rubbish
source:
Callahan, a resident of the trash pits far outside the city, finds a discarded robot, and sets about what he does best, fixing things.

[From [url=https://aderie.itch.io/utter-rubbish]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
居住在远离城市郊外垃圾场里的卡拉汉捡到了一台废弃机器人，随即动手干起了他最拿手的老本行——修修补补。

[摘自[url=https://aderie.itch.io/utter-rubbish]Itch.io[/url]]
